messages:
Priya S: Cloudway requested a short technical playbook + SSO checklist before Wed demo. Who can own the playbook?
Alex M: I can take it. Will produce a one-pager and a short runbook. Do we have their SAML SP metadata?
Priya S: Ben from Cloudway sent SP metadata this morning and asked for outbound IPs and cert rotation policy. I'll add the metadata to the doc.
Alex M: Cert rotation = 90 days. Outbound NAT IPs we'll provide from Dedicated. I'll add both to the playbook.
Dan R: @Sam (security) the partner questionnaire includes questions on customer KMS, data residency, and log retention. Can you handle answers?
Sam (security): Yep. We support customer-managed KMS for Private, HSM on-prem. Hosted uses envelope encryption; legal needs to sign off on KMS addendum. Standard log retention = 12 months, 18 months available as enterprise add-on. SOC2 link: https://redwood.app/compliance/soc2.pdf
Mia K: Pricing ask: they want a blended pilot rate for 3 months. Estimate avg QPS 30, spikes to 200 for ~10min. Any fast guidance?
Dan R: Suggest reserved pilot capacity + burst credits. Recommend base commit = 2x sustained (60 QPS) + 30% pilot discount for first 3 months. I'll draft numbers and loop in finance.
Priya S: They also want auto-fallback to a smaller model when capacity hits. Can the routing do that?
Alex M: Yes. Smart routing supports fallback by model/latency. I'll include a short JSON example in the playbook.
Mia K: Timeline: demo Wed AM. Deliverables due Tue EOD: playbook, finalized SAML, pricing. Owners?
Alex M: Playbook/runbook = me. Will post draft link here when ready.
Dan R: Pricing = me; sending draft to finance (cc Kevin).
Sam (security): Questionnaire and artifacts = me. Note: legal follow-up expected on KMS and extended retention.
Priya S: Blockers to escalate: (1) partner sign-off on SAML metadata, (2) finance sign-off on pilot pricing, (3) final outbound IP list. Flag here if any slip.
Alex M: Uploaded draft playbook: https://redwood.app/drive/cloudway-playbook — please review SSO section.
Dan R: Pricing draft sent to finance. Will update after feedback.
Sam (security): Questionnaire uploaded. Linked SOC2 and pen test.
Mia K: I'll schedule partner enablement Thurs 10am PT (45m). Invite to follow.
Priya S: Quick sync tomorrow 11am PT to confirm. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
